title: ControllerSettings
description: What a controller was configured to do, at a moment in time. Written to the `settings` collection, which cgm-remote-monitor already enables on v3 — so this needs no new endpoint. Publish on change, not per cycle. Everything here is effective-dated and build-versioned, because a setting that changed mid-history invalidates a replay that assumed one value.

effectiveFrom.description: When these settings took effect. Not when the document was written.

version.description: The build. Algorithm behaviour changes between releases, so a setting without one cannot be replayed against the right code.

settings.description: Every member optional: a controller publishes what it has. Absent means not published, which is different from a default — and is exactly what a replay needs to know.

automaticBolusApplicationFactor.description: The fraction of a recommended bolus that is actually delivered, defaulting to 0.4. It scales every automatic dose Loop gives, is user-adjustable in some builds, and is recorded nowhere. Two sites with identical therapy settings and identical glucose will dose differently, and nothing in Nightscout says why.

carbAbsorptionModel.description: Piecewise-linear versus nonlinear carb absorption changes the carb effect curve, and so the dose.

maxActiveInsulinMultiplier.description: Loop's IOB ceiling, as a multiple of maxBolus. Defaults to 2.

maxBasal.description: Loop records this as loopSettings.maximumBasalRatePerHour. AAPS and Trio record no equivalent.

maxIob.description: A dosing *safety limit*. Loop records its equivalents in profile.loopSettings. The corpus holds no maxIob from any oref0 derivative, so a replay of corpus data must assume it. oref0's own rig uploads its preferences file, max_iob included, as devicestatus.preferences (oref0 d219baf9 bin/ns-status.js:40-49,175-177, called with --preferences by bin/oref0-ns-loop.sh:221-227); the corpus has no oref0 rig. Trio and AndroidAPS upload no equivalent.

microBolusAllowed.description: Whether SMB was permitted on this run. Inferable after the fact from whether an SMB was enacted, which is not the same thing — a run that allowed SMB and chose not to is indistinguishable from one that forbade it.

recommendationInsulinModel.description: Which insulin activity curve the recommendation uses. `insulinType` on a treatment names the product, which is related but not the same choice.

recommendationType.description: `dosingStrategy` distinguishes automaticBolus from tempBasalOnly, which covers the common case but is not the same enumeration.

suspendThreshold.description: Loop-only, under the same subtree. oref0 derivatives write `openaps.suggested.threshold`, which is the computed threshold rather than the configured one.

useIntegralRetrospectiveCorrection.description: Integral RC is a materially different correction behaviour and a user-facing toggle.

x-aid-extensions.description: Vendor settings with no agreed name yet.
